component.name: Open Audio Analyzer
component.summary: Loudness and spectrum metering for mixing, mastering and delivery

description.p: Open Audio Analyzer is a free and open-source loudness and spectrum analyzer: an arrangeable canvas of meter modules driven by presets, delivery targets and skins.

Loudness follows EBU R 128 and ITU-R BS.1770-4 — momentary, short-term and integrated LUFS, loudness range, and true peak by four-times oversampling — and is held against the EBU Tech 3341 and 3342 conformance vectors on every build. What Open Audio Analyzer has not measured it does not draw: an unavailable quantity is a dash, never a zero.

ul.li: Number Box, LUFS Meter, Digital Meter and Super Meter
VU Meter with a real second-order movement
Spectrum Analyzer, Spectrogram, Phase Scope and Stereo Cloud

description.p: Files can be analysed offline against a delivery target, from the application or from the bundled command-line analyser. A tablet on the same network can mirror the canvas as a second display.

Thirteen modules that all measure something. Loudness, true peak and the spectrum are held against the EBU R128 and BS.2217 reference vectors in CI. Layouts, delivery targets and skins persist; files are analysed offline; a tablet mirrors the canvas over the network, and a headless VST3 or AU plugin streams a DAW's audio to the desk.
